brand_voice_note: Calm, dignity-first and reassuring - it speaks softly to a private concern with practical, proven design details that hand control back to the user and their family.

concepts.primary_text:
Walk out the door without a second thought.

LEGG-INS supports and conceals your leg bag so you feel like yourself again - comfort and confidence, all day.

Patented, lightweight nylon with two adjustable straps that stay put on your thigh or calf. No more worrying about the embarrassment of visible waste bags.
concepts.headline: Confidence you can wear out
concepts.why_it_works: The single most desirable outcome for this user is freedom to live normally, so leading with the everyday-out feeling lands harder than listing features.
concepts.visual_direction: A man out walking on a sunny sidewalk, shown from the waist down, with the black leg bag cover worn discreetly on his calf.

concepts.primary_text:
Worried it won't actually hold up? Look closer.

Every LEGG-INS feature exists to solve a real frustration - two adjustable straps that don't slip, a mesh window so you can check the fill level without undressing, and easy release-valve access.

US patented, durable nylon, and washable wash after wash. A smart, dependable choice.
concepts.headline: Built to earn your trust
concepts.why_it_works: The biggest hesitation for a private, functional purchase is 'will it really work,' so a labelled spec breakdown kills the doubt with concrete, proven design.
concepts.visual_direction: A clean spec-sheet style shot of the leg bag cover with five short labels pointing to its key features.

concepts.primary_text:
A drainage bag shouldn't decide how you feel in your own home.

BAG-INS neatly conceals and supports your 2000 mL bag right on the wheelchair frame, so it sits tidy and out of sight.

The removable dowel rod keeps its shape and reduces tubing kinks - practical support that helps restore dignity, every day.
concepts.headline: Tidy, secure, out of sight
concepts.why_it_works: The daily friction of a visible, sagging drainage bag is exactly what this product removes, so naming that problem and its clean fix speaks straight to the user and their family.
concepts.visual_direction: The black drainage bag cover hanging tidily on a wheelchair frame in a bright, homey room, with a seated person shown from the chest down.

concepts.primary_text:
We built BAG-INS because 'discreet enough' wasn't good enough.

So we added max-release buckles, a woven carry handle, double zipper openings, two private pockets, and a removable dowel rod that keeps its shape.

Every detail is here for one reason - comfort, security, and peace of mind for the people who use it and the families who love them.
concepts.headline: Designed to restore dignity
concepts.why_it_works: The 'unlike other covers' origin and patent-pending detail make a founder-story angle natural, letting the callouts double as proof of an advocate's intent.
concepts.visual_direction: A clean spec-sheet style shot of the black drainage bag cover with five short labels pointing to its buckles, handle, zippers, pockets, and dowel rod.
